reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00403950 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403950-GOGfxDisp.cpp at sha256 ca91438f6f2d4ae296cf0dcb012b86ee4ddfd7c798e88212c1238d6f73f23db8 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOGfxDisp(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail frame slot [E+0xc]; BN (int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc); the candidate's param_2 sits at [E+8].The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00403950; radare2 recovers "fcn.00403950 (int32_t arg_24h, int32_t arg_28h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00403950 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOGfxDisp(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
